snippet.title: Beijing 2008 - Gameplay (1080p60fps)
snippet.description:
Beijing 2008 - Gameplay (1080p60fps).

Beijing 2008 is the official Olympic video game of the 2008 Summer Olympics. Developed by Eurocom and published by Sega, the game was the second video game based on the 2008 Summer Olympics to be released, the first being the fantasy-based Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games. It was released in 2008 for the PlayStation 3, Xbox 360 and Microsoft Windows.
